web-optimized.description: H.264 optimized for browser streaming and web delivery
web-optimized.use_case: YouTube, Vimeo, web players, general distribution
web-optimized.example: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset slow -profile:v high -level 4.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart output.mp4

high-quality.description: High-quality H.264 for archive masters and pristine delivery
high-quality.use_case: Client deliverables, archiving, source for future transcodes
high-quality.example: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset veryslow -profile:v high -level 4.2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart output.mp4

social-media-vertical.description: 9:16 portrait video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
social-media-vertical.use_case: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Stories
notes: Max file size: 287.6 MB for TikTok, 4 GB for Instagram
Max duration: 60s TikTok (short), 3 min TikTok (long), 90s Reels
social-media-vertical.example: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1080:1920:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black" -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart output.mp4

social-media-square.description: 1:1 square video for Instagram Feed and Facebook
social-media-square.use_case: Instagram feed posts, Facebook video, LinkedIn
notes: Instagram: max 4 GB, max 60s for feed video
social-media-square.example: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "scale=1080:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1080:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black" -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart output.mp4

fast-preview.description: Fast, low-quality proxy for review and editing preview
fast-preview.use_case: Client review links, editing proxy, quick previews
notes: Encodes 5–10× faster than real-time on modern hardware
Not suitable for final delivery — use for review only
fast-preview.example: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "scale=1280:-2" -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset ultrafast -profile:v baseline -level 3.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 96k -movflags +faststart preview.mp4

lossless-intermediate.description: Lossless FFV1 for post-production intermediate and archiving
lossless-intermediate.use_case: Intermediate between editing stages, long-term preservation
notes: Lossless — no quality loss across multiple encode/decode cycles
Large file size (~1–3 GB per minute at 1080p)
FFV1 level 3 supports multithreading and error detection

ebu_r128_streaming.description: EBU R128 for online streaming platforms
